text: Objectives The graduate program in Mechanical Engineering provides students with solid theory and the latest technological knowledge. The program has a practical orientation and aims to equip engineers with knowledge in modern experimental methods and research skills that allow them to meet the complexities of today’s challenges in the field of mechanical engineering. Students are expected to engage in scientific research, and to assume leadership role in the mechanical industries. Duration Duration of the program is between 1.5-2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Design and Manufacturing 2. Mechatronics and Automation 3. Fluid and Heat Transfer Credit Units Students need to successfully complete at least 27 credits units. Of the 27 credits units required, 12 must be core courses, 10 must be elective courses, 3 must be experimental and thematic courses, and 2 must be practical courses. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship
